entry: New 'Plan ahead' drawer: queue purchases for the next few rounds and see a projected score, funds, methane per round and coupling for 5 or 10 rounds, next to doing nothing and next to the pure-growth baseline. It runs on a copy, so your real farm and your save are never touched.

The policy advisor now has a pool of six offers (decoupling subsidy, cash bonus, carbon-credit contract, feed-price hedge, organic label trial, welfare grant), two at a time and none repeated until the pool is used. Each has a plain real-world tag, and an Advisor history in the Collection panel and a line on the report card list what you took and what you passed on.

Ranch rules: four sliders in Settings (starting funds, season swing, pressure penalty, growth-cost slope) for custom runs. Any change makes the run unranked: it stays off the community leaderboard and out of the other-farms comparison, and the score-400 achievement is not available on custom rules. A badge says so, and Back to standard rules puts everything right.

New 'Why this number?' panel: pick Income per round, Methane per round, Coupling ratio or Pressure and see exactly where it comes from, piece by piece (herd base income, plant-based blend, certification, welfare, poultry, satellite, supply chain, season, pressure, biogas; methane per animal group; each lever's cut in the coupling ratio; the pressure curve and its cap). It updates live as you play.

Hard words now explain themselves. In the small 'i' notes, the intro and the How to Play steps, the first mention of coupling ratio, decoupling, baseline farm, welfare, capture systems, pressure, sustainable certification and methane-equivalent has a dotted underline; hover it, tab to it or tap it for a short plain-language definition, and press Esc to close it. How to Play also ends with the whole glossary.

Every achievement you have not earned now shows how far along you are. Hover over a card (or tab to it, or tap it on a phone) and a small bar fills in with the exact amount left, such as '8 herd units to go (2 of 10)'. This now covers First Herd, First Steps, Full Toolkit, Sustainably Certified, Plant Pioneer, Beating the Baseline and Clean Operator as well as the percentage and count achievements that already had a line.

Settings has a new option, Ask before a big purchase (never, or over 25%, 50% or 75% of your funds). When a purchase, or a whole x5 or Max batch, costs more than that share of the funds you have, a confirmation shows the cost and the share first. It is off by default.

If a save cannot be read (for example a hand-edited code with a letter where a number belongs), Herd no longer half-loads it. A notice at the top now says in plain words which values are the problem, your current farm stays exactly as it was, and you can either keep it or load the save with a fresh-farm value in place of only the bad fields.

Herd is now fully playable from the keyboard. On any buy button (Grow Herd, Feed Additives, Herd Caps, Capture Systems, the pivot and the extras) the Up and Down arrows move to the next or previous buy button and Home and End jump to the first or last; on x1, x5 and Max the Left and Right arrows pick how many units each purchase buys. How to Play ends with a short keyboard cheat sheet, and the ? shortcut list gains the same two lines.

Settings has three new switches. High contrast turns the page black with white text, solid outlines and a thick yellow focus ring. Easy-read font swaps in a clear sans-serif stack with wider letter and word spacing. Pattern fills and shape markers give the methane bar a diagonal stripe, the new welfare bar dots and the new supply-chain bar vertical stripes, and mark every round on the methane graph with a shape (a square when the round added less methane than the one before, a circle otherwise, a diamond for the latest), so colour is never the only cue. Reset to Default turns all three off. The Report Card button also no longer says Loading... when the page first opens.

The feedback box at the end now asks a second question about Herd's own lesson: did decoupling feel like a real strategy, or a tax on growth? Answer both questions and the Submit button unlocks; your comment is still optional.

A batch of play-quality changes. Buy in steps: an x1 / x5 / Max stepper above Grow Herd makes the Grow Herd and the three decoupling buttons buy several units at once and show the total cost first. After each Advance Round, small chips show how Funds, Methane, Welfare and Pressure moved (with a triangle and a sign, so colour is never the only cue); click one to pin it, otherwise it fades. Undo last round rewinds the farm to just before you pressed Advance Round, once per game, for a 25-funds fee. With market and weather variation on, a 12-round calendar shows each coming season's income swing and the plant-based demand surges. The poultry panel has a cattle against poultry table, each breeding line shows a ring counting down its three rounds, every animal in the herd has a name (hover a pasture cow), and the longest-serving animals of a retired generation go into a hall of fame under Collection. A discreet line under the round counter tracks your pace, and every ten rounds in one sitting a toast suggests saving and taking a break.

New: the Report Card has a Copy result button that copies one line, such as Herd, 412 score, with your rating, round, how far you have decoupled and methane avoided. Every achievement you have earned now has a Share button that copies a line you can paste anywhere, with the share of players who have it when that figure is available. The How to Play and Info panels link to the new Credits page.

A collector's batch. A breed shelf (eleven breeds, including a hidden Methane-Eater Cow for a very clean, very happy herd) and a combo book of named lever combinations that each pay a small one-off bonus, both kept across generations and found under Collection, or in the Desktop Menu. Perfect rounds (less methane than the last round and more funds than it ended with) build a streak with bonuses at 3, 5 and 10. Every lever now shows its funds per methane saved, the regional cap has a headroom bar with rounds until you must decouple, a lever history lists every purchase and can be filtered, and the report card gains a rating title ladder and a three-line highlights reel. Advance Round now announces its result to screen readers.

New Desktop layout for wide windows: the round, funds, herd, methane, coupling ratio, pressure and score as chips across the top, the pasture and the coupling gauge filling the screen, and Advance Round, Grow Herd and every decoupling investment in a column on the right. Status, the baseline farm comparison, the leaderboard and feedback open as windows from the Menu. Pick Desktop or Classic from the opening screen; your save works in both.
The sentence under the title now reacts to your session: it changes when methane pressure builds, when you are half decoupled, and once the farm is certified (R-23).

Story mode: the Marlow Farm story. A short chapter is added to a collapsible Story panel for each achievement you earn, from the first calf to a century farm. It is optional, follows the existing Story on/off pill, and never changes your save (W1).
Community leaderboard: an opt-in 'best decoupling gap' board ranked by your score minus what pure growth would have scored (F21).
The community comparison now shows a small trend arrow (▲/▼/▶) against your own last check, remembered on this device — no backend change needed (F10).

Satellite farm: once your main herd reaches 6 you can open a smaller, older second farm with its own coupling ratio, size limit and barn retrofits. Decoupling your main farm past 40% spills over and cuts the satellite's emissions too, up to half — a regional herd network (F1).
Farm succession: a certified farm can be handed to the next generation for legacy points that buy permanent perks, including a Heritage Flock that keeps poultry available from round 1 (F25).
New achievement, Sustainably Certified, for earning the permanent sustainable-certification price premium. It replaces the separate one-off pop-up that used to announce that moment.
Achievement cards now show "Earned by N% of players" once enough real save data exists for that achievement (site-wide goal, Z1/Z27b).
The real-world comparison (F15) now shows an actual chart, not just a sentence: your emissions-intensity cut plotted against the documented ~42% real-farm benchmark (site-wide goal, Z17).
Added a keyboard-shortcuts help overlay: press ? to see it, Esc to close it or whichever panel is open (site-wide goal, Z4).
Settings panel: added a "Reset to Default" button that resets text size and reduce-motion back to their defaults in one click (site-wide goal, folded from A26).
The Report Card is now print-friendly: printing the page (e.g. Ctrl/Cmd+P) while it's open hides the site chrome and renders it in clean dark-on-white, instead of the site's usual dark theme and UI.
Fixed a display bug where the Achievements/What's New panels showed as empty boxes before their first open and never visually closed again once opened once.
A second herd type: once your farm earns sustainable certification you can diversify into a poultry flock with its own low-emission curve, levers and upkeep (F23).
New Farm operations panel: breeding programs that mature over rounds, processing and distribution income, herd welfare, and short farm-tour vignettes (F5, F13, F15, F17).
Optional scenarios: market and weather variation with plant-based demand surges, and a regional methane cap that blocks growth until you decouple (F9, F3, F19).
Policy advisor: every 8 rounds choose a decoupling subsidy or a cash bonus (F27). Surplus Capture Systems now sell biogas, as real farms do (F29).
F7: the report card now compares your lifetime methane against every other player's, once enough farms have saved to compare against.

F8: a small diamond marker on the coupling gauge showing the best (lowest) decoupling ratio this browser has ever reached across sessions, plus a matching "Best ever" label — persisted via localStorage, separate from the gauge's own live reading.

Round-2 pass: sustainable certification (permanent price premium), before/after arrows on the Grow preview, herd count on the pasture, thinning methane wisps, exact income tradeoff in the pivot confirm, report-card percentage vs baseline, and more.
F16: added a confirmation prompt before investing in the Plant-Based Pivot, the pricier of the two decoupling paths.
Added a settings panel (text size + reduced motion) and completed a colorblind-safety audit — the coupling gauge was already redundantly coded (length + text labels), no change needed.
Achievements framework added (18 achievements) plus a large improvement pass: pure-growth counterfactual comparison, a report card panel, a methane trend graph, and milestone-nudge toasts.
Added a skippable tutorial, a How to Play page, and a mobile sticky HUD.
Full visual redesign: pastoral farmland backdrop, glass panels, icon labels and investment chips.
Integrated the shared save widget and fixed load_state() crashing outright on a save missing a top-level field.
Pass 3 audit: confirmed the coupling ratio already drives scoring through two independent paths, added regression tests to lock it in.
Added an in-game Info Page with real-world methane sources; Pass 2 added the alternative-protein (plant-based) pivot as a second decoupling path.
Iteration pass: a prominent coupling-ratio gauge and an ambient haze overlay tracking the methane meter.
All 7 core milestones shipped: core farm loop, coupled methane meter, decoupling measures, soft consequence system, scoring/hope-angle payoff, feedback prompt, and hub integration.
